market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Iran-driven oil spike and rate-hike repricing. Equities likely choppy with sector rotation away from rate-sensitive growth. Oil above current levels sustains inflation fears. Crypto volatile but Solana fundamentals supportive. JPMorgan sees rotation driving gains, not broad rallies.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (trillions over 5 years) supports tech leadership but concentration risk demands diversification. Japan capital investment cycle and US-China decoupling (gallium, logistics) create structural winners. Housing corrections in Australia and potential US affordability squeeze moderate growth. Energy transition and quantum computing are 3-5 year themes.
